{{Top|leg}}
An '''adhesive defib strip''' was a medical tool. It was placed over a patient's [[Heart/Legends|heart]] and delivered an electrical signal into the chest. [[Maglenna Pendower]] used an adhesive defib strip, along with a [[pressure resuscitator]] and an [[adrenaline patch]], to save the life of [[Morgan Q. Raventhorn]].<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
